subject: mathematics
concept: Writing and graphing linear equations in slope-intercept form (y=mx+b)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student plots the y-intercept and uses slope to plot additional points on a physical grid
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a slope-intercept equation to its correctly graphed line
exercise.abstract: Student writes the equation of a line given its slope and y-intercept, and graphs a given equation

misconception_flags: confuses which value in y=mx+b represents slope versus y-intercept

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
